en.html:
The iron giant had gone silent.
A deep horizontal fissure lay open across it, and under the moon it glittered, a mountain of scrap that had finished being anything else.

I dragged myself up the heap on a leg that had stopped taking orders, and hauled out the Rokuhara-standard dragoon hanging from the crack as if he had spilled out of it. The man who had piloted the giant was out cold.

I dumped him on the ground without ceremony and looked into the fissure. Past layers of crossing girders, shut in cages, I could see <ruby>them<rt>・・</rt></ruby>, <ruby>huddled<rt>huddled</rt></ruby> together.

Nobody moved.
Pressed against one another, stiff and still.

A block of ice slid down inside me along the breastbone.
No voice came. Calling their names and finding out if they lived is a simple job, and fear had blocked it.

en.html:
Her bleached thoughts overlaid my field of consciousness, which had gone exactly the same.
I did not know what to do. I did not even know what to think.

ja.html: 景明 「――――」

en.html:
My thoughts stayed white.
They gave birth to no idea at all.

The howling demon cannon—
I stood and listened to the funeral march composed for me.

Unable to do anything.
Standing stiff like a scarecrow.

I waited for a meaningless end.
My frozen heart could not even grieve at the meaninglessness.

ja.html:
思考は、ただ白いまま。
　何の知恵も産み落とさない。

　唸りを上げる魔砲――
　俺のための葬送曲を、立ち尽くして聴く。

　何もできず。
　案山子のように、棒立ちで。

　俺は無意味な最期を待つ。
　凍った心は、その無意味さを悲しむ事さえできない。
